description: Unit test class for MutablePermissions, testing various aspects such as addition, removal, equality, JSON serialization, and hashCode/equals behavior.

classes.name: MutablePermissionsTest
classes.description: Test class for MutablePermissions, covering behaviors like adding, removing, equality, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the mutable permissions instance before each test.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies correct implementation of hashCode and equals; ignored because of superclass extension issue.

methods.name: tryToAddNull
methods.description: Test that adding null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: addNonExistingEntry
methods.description: Tests adding a new permission and verifies it gets added.

methods.name: addExistingEntryAgain
methods.description: Tests that adding an existing permission does not duplicate and returns false.

methods.name: createNewMutablePermissionsFromGivenSet
methods.description: Creates a MutablePermissions instance from an EnumSet and verifies contents.

methods.name: removeExistingEntry
methods.description: Removes an existing permission and verifies it is removed.

methods.name: removeNonExistingEntry
methods.description: Verifies that removing a non-existent permission returns false and instance remains empty.

methods.name: containsWorksAsExpected
methods.description: Checks that contains() reports correct presence for individual and multiple permissions.

methods.name: createJsonRepresentationOfEmptyMutablePermissions
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization of an empty permissions set.

methods.name: createJsonRepresentationOfMutablePermissions
methods.description: Verifies JSON serialization after adding all permissions.
